name: onboarding-api
description: Single backend for onboardings, tasks, notes and overdue/due-soon computation. Seeds the default task set when an onboarding starts, and computes overdue flags from due dates. A department team member's department is derived from which department scopes (tasks:*-it, tasks:*-hr, tasks:*-facilities) the gateway's signed assertion carries; the assertion holds sub, username and scope only, never groups, and the department-specific /me/it, /me/hr and /me/facilities operations each serve only that department's tasks. Reminders are returned as data only; it sends no email or notifications and stores no files. It does not serve the UI. Persistent storage is not yet provisioned: no database resource type is registered in this organization.
